home.intro: Open a domino table, share the code, and play with your friends while you talk.

auth.birthdateHint: ICOSIUM is for people aged 16 and over.
auth.guestIntro: Try ICOSIUM in one tap. Your guest account stays on this device.

error.tooYoung: You must be at least 16 to join ICOSIUM.
error.invalidBirthdate: Please enter a valid date of birth.
error.emailTaken: An account already exists with this email.
error.invalidUsername: Usernames use 3 to 20 letters, numbers or underscores.
error.weakPassword: Your password needs at least 8 characters.
error.ageNotConfirmed: Please confirm you are 16 or older.
error.network: Can't reach ICOSIUM right now. Check your connection and try again.
error.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
error.emailNotConfirmed: Please confirm your email first: open the link we sent you.
error.guestDisabled: Guest mode is turned off for now. Create an account instead.
error.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
error.signupRefused: We couldn't create your account. Check your date of birth and username.

auth.checkEmail: Almost there! Open the email we just sent you to confirm your account, then sign in.
auth.guestNameHint: 3 to 20 letters, digits or underscores. Leave empty for a random one.

voice.title: Voice room
voice.intro: Up to 4 people. Everyone arrives with their mic off.
voice.micHint: Tap to turn your mic on or off. Hold to talk.
voice.full: This voice room is full (4 people).
voice.micDenied: ICOSIUM can't use your microphone. Allow it in your browser settings.
voice.error: Couldn't join the voice room. Please try again.

profile.title: Profile
profile.navigateHint: Switch pages while in the voice room: the voice bar stays on top.

play.title: Domino
play.subtitle: Algerian double-six, 2 players or 4 in teams.
play.createHint: You're the boss: you choose the rules.
play.joinHint: Enter the 4-letter code a friend sent you.

error.seat_taken: Someone just took that seat. Try again.
error.rate_limited: You opened a lot of tables. Wait a few minutes.
error.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

play.soloHint: Start right away, bots take the other seats.

domino.waitingHint: The game starts as soon as every seat is taken.
domino.shareText: Come play domino with me on ICOSIUM! Table code: {code}

error.conflict: The table moved on. Try again.
error.not_seated: You are not seated at this table.
error.unknown: Couldn't play that tile. Try again.

domino.consultUs: Your team opens: talk it over
domino.consultThem: The other team is deciding who opens
domino.fillBotsHint: Free seats go to bots and the game starts.
domino.redealSixDoubles: 6 doubles in one hand: the tiles are dealt again.
domino.redealFamily: {name} asked for a redeal: new hand.
domino.kept: {name} keeps the hand: their team scores nothing this round.
domino.declareMine: You were dealt 6 tiles of the {n} family.
domino.declareOther: {name} was dealt 6 tiles of the {n} family.
domino.declareExplain: Redeal: shuffle and deal again. Keep: play on, but the keeping team scores nothing this round, the points go to the opponents.
domino.roundReplay: Nobody scores: the round is replayed and the double-six opens.
domino.penalized: Hand kept: the points go to the other team.
